body.prompt: Edit target: the attached existing UV texture atlas for the game's Primordial Baphomet. This is an exact-layout texture edit for an existing skinned 3D model, not a concept illustration. Keep the square canvas and EVERY UV island boundary, silhouette, placement, scale and orientation exactly where it is. Preserve the one large bright gold vertical-pupil forehead eye and the two CLOSED normal eyes, facial anatomy, fingers, limbs, muscles, and existing irregular keratin growth pattern. Improve ONLY the surface material: ancient dark ash-charcoal living demonic hide, dry and matte, with natural coarse pores, fine fissures, leathery folds, and weathered bone/keratin embedded in the skin. Remove the oily rubber/plastic and polished metallic appearance. Reduce broad smooth specular highlights; use subtle readable mid-tone relief, deep crevices and restrained desaturated grey-brown keratin accents, maintaining a dark ominous silhouette. Fine microtexture must sit on the existing anatomy without rearranging or distorting it. Preserve enough tonal contrast to read at small in-game scale, avoid crushing the entire atlas to black. No blood, gore, new eyes, open side eyes, emissive cracks, blue color, armor plates, extra anatomy, text, framing, or background changes. Output the improved texture atlas alone, straight-on, same square UV layout.

horn.prompt: Create a production-ready seamless game texture for ancient demonic antlers and keratin spikes. Texture only, a completely flat orthographic macro material field filling the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge, landscape 3:2 canvas. This is not a picture of an antler, no object silhouette, no background or margins. Dark charcoal-grey keratin with a very restrained desaturated brown undertone, dry matte rough surface, organic lengthwise grooves flowing vertically, irregular fine fissures, small chipped worn ridge edges and subtle layered growth bands. Dense naturally varied physical detail at multiple scales, moderately readable midtone grooves for a dark fantasy 3D monster at small game scale. Soft neutral diffuse lighting evenly over the whole image, no baked directional shadow, bright reflection, gloss, polish, metal or plastic. Not pure flat black; ridge values gently distinguish from crevices, but keep the material distinctly darker than beige bone. No blood, veins, glowing cracks, colored emission, runes, decoration, text, symbols, watermark, grid, swatches, dividers or arrangement. Seamless/tileable material, edge to edge.
